environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) connected to Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15.4. The DB_USER is 'inventory_service' which has been granted full DML privileges on the inventory schema (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables). The Lambda is invoked via API Gateway with no request validation template. The inventory.quantity column is defined as INTEGER (int4, 32-bit signed). No application-level bounds checking on computed values before DB write.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA inventory TO inventory_service
config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validator, proxy integration
